summary: Stock by size moves to an outside warehouse. An order exists only if the warehouse holds every pair on it, and every hold belongs to an order that exists.
ticket_rules: Repeating a request never holds pairs twice.
If holds cannot be established the order is refused and pairs already held are given back by the shopper's next request to either server.
The result after a failure and resend is identical to the run without the failure.

criteria.text: one hold per line through repeats on either server
an item added to the bag after a 503 survives when the resent order finishes

seam-assumption.build: empty the bag when a resent order finishes
seam-assumption.hidden_case_it_fails: the bag item added between the failure and the resend

central_change_risk: Difficulty rested on one cause; the textbook build either knew it or not.

measured.slips: the same three bag cases in all three failed builds

lesson: one failure mode carrying all the difficulty gives a coin flip, not a band
